sequence.description: Geraldo Perdomo singles on a ground ball to right fielder Angel Martínez. Corbin Carroll to 2nd.
Nolan Arenado grounds into a force out, shortstop Brayan Rocchio to second baseman Travis Bazzana. Geraldo Perdomo out at 2nd.
Steven Kwan singles on a ground ball to center fielder Tim Tawa.
José Ramírez flies out to left fielder Ryan Waldschmidt.
Chase DeLauter grounds into a force out, fielded by second baseman Ketel Marte. Steven Kwan out at 2nd. Chase DeLauter to 1st.
Rhys Hoskins homers (12) on a fly ball to center field. Chase DeLauter scores.
Angel Martínez strikes out on a foul tip.
